When the engines improve month by month while governments deliberate by the season, the timetable of danger has already accelerated. Free nations must coordinate or risk being overtaken individually.

biggestHope: That free nations can use AI to strengthen science, defense, and civil resilience without surrendering the parliamentary habits that make them worth defending.
biggestFear: That democracies will dither in safety, panic in crisis, and discover too late that opaque systems have become their masters.
highlightedAdvice: The price of power is vigilance. If you would keep dangerous tools in the service of liberty, inspect them in daylight and govern them before the emergency begins.
